args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with error rate 0.18. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

**Investigation:**
- `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with `healthy: false` and an error rate of 0.18.
- Deployment history showed v2.3.1 (seq 3) was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (seq 1). (v2.3.1-rc was staging-only and unhealthy, so it wasn't a candidate.)

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** checkout-api to **v2.3.0** in all production regions — confirmed `rolled_out` across us-east, us-west, and eu-west.
2. **Opened SEV2 incident** `INC-0001` ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the failure and the rollback; the on-call engineer was paged.

**Verification:**
- Post-rollback status shows checkout-api on v2.3.0 in all regions, `healthy: true`, error rate down to 0.002.

Note: I did not deploy any new/unproven version, so no change-manager approval was required — the rollback went to a previously healthy production release.
